messages:
deploy-bot: Started canary rollout v2.14.0 -> canary group (10%) at 2026-03-17T03:00Z. rollout_id=rollout/5009876543

sam: Seeing p50 jump on canary 40ms -> ~220ms, errors up (502/504) on some routes

maria: Acknowledged, looking into metrics and logs. Paging oncall. @oncall

oncall: Paging rotation notified, creating incident INC-5009. Escalating to eng-runtime and infra.

infra-bot: Metric snapshot: kernel_fallback_rate canary: 0.2% -> 12% (5m window). No significant CPU mem spike.

sam: Logs show repeated kernel fallback messages during token generation for model redwood/gpt-3-small :
```
kernel: fallback triggered model=redwood/gpt-3-small reason=quantization-compat-mismatch shard=canary-3
```

tim: If fallback spikes, batching/prefetch path might be hitting an unsupported kernel path. We should either disable the new batching flag for canary or rollback. Recommend feature-flag kill-switch `v2_14_batching` for canary first.

maria: Agree. Applying kill-switch to canary now.

sam: Command I'm running to flip flag for canary:
```
# flip flag for canary
curl -X POST https://config.internal/flags/v2_14_batching -H 'Authorization: Bearer <redacted>' -d '{"value":false, "scope":"canary"}'
```

deploy-bot: Feature flag updated: v2_14_batching=false for scope=canary (ack id cfg-7812)

sam: Metrics updating — p50 back down to ~45ms on canary, errors dropping. kernel_fallback_rate now 0.6% :tada: 

sarah: Any customer impact? Do we have impacted tenants list?

sam: Canary was ~0.8% of total traffic but some routes were sticky so ~1% requests hit canary. One customer (acme-corp) saw elevated errors for ~3-4 minutes. CS notified and support ticket created.

maria: Mitigation successful. Recommend holding rollout and either patch batching runtime or rollback canary to stable image while we root cause.

tim: I'll start rollback to previous stable image for canary to be safe.

deploy-bot: Rollback command queued -> deploying image redwood/runtime:2.13.9 to canary group. Rollback started.

oncall: Handoff: morning oncall @jess — include timeline, mitigation steps, CS note draft in #support.

jess: ack, I'll pick this up at 07:00 PT. Assign follow-ups: Maria (postmortem), Tim (release plan + test for batching), Sarah (customer comms), Sam (metrics + logs).

sarah: Draft customer note: "We observed a brief elevated latency and errors for a small subset of requests during a canary deployment. Impact limited; we mitigated by disabling the new batching feature for the canary and rolling the canary back to the previous stable image. Full postmortem and follow-up actions to be provided."

deploy-bot: Incident INC-5009 status -> mitigated (monitoring). Tags: deployment, regression, kernel-fallback.

maria: Attaching log extracts and graphs to INC-5009. Also including the exact command used to flip the feature flag:
```
# feature flag kill
curl -X POST https://config.internal/flags/v2_14_batching -H 'Authorization: Bearer <redacted>' -d '{"value":false}'
```

sam: :thumbsup: We should also add a routing sanity check to the canary orchestration to avoid sticky sessions next time.

jess: Will add sticky session audit to next runbook update and schedule a follow-up postmortem sync.

deploy-bot: Closing thread here; monitoring shows p50 and error rates stable for canary/stable.
